name: アーケード
css: /* --- LED Lights (修正: 点滅をゆっくりに) --- */
.led-lights { position: absolute; border-radius: 50%; animation: led-blink 3s ease-in-out infinite; }
.led-1 { top: 2%; left: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #ff0000; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ff0000; animation-delay: 0s; }
.led-2 { top: 2%; right: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #ffff00; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #ffff00; animation-delay: 0.5s; }
.led-3 { bottom: 2%; left: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #00ff00; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00ff00; animation-delay: 1.0s; }
.led-4 { bottom: 2%; right: 10%; width: 15px; height: 15px; background: #00ffff; box-shadow: 0 0 15px #00ffff; animation-delay: 1.5s; }
/* --- Pointer (修正: 位置微調整 & シアン色維持) --- */
@keyframes pointer-glow { from { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 10px #00ffff); } to { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 20px #00ffff) drop-shadow(0 0 30px #00ffff); } }
/* --- Center Button (修正: 虹色回転を削除してシックに) --- */
/* ギラギラした虹色グラデーションを削除し、ダークな同心円デザインに変更 */

.button-outer { position: absolute; width: 100%; height: 100%; background: radial-gradient(circle, #2a2a40 0%, #16213e 60%, #000000 100%); border: 2px solid #00ff00; border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: inset 0 0 15px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.3); }

.button-inner { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: 75%; height: 75%; border-radius: 50%; background: #1a1a2e; border: 2px solid #00ff00; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 18px; color: #00ff00; text-shadow: 0 0 10px #00ff00; font-weight: bold; box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.2), inset 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); animation: pulse-green 3s ease-in-out infinite; }

@keyframes pulse-green { 0%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.3), inset 0 0 10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8); text-shadow: 0 0 5px #00ff00; } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.6), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); text-shadow: 0 0 15px #00ff00; } }
display: flex; justify-content: center; align-items: center;
